text:
Maya: FYI tenant 'aurora' reported a flood of duplicate SCIM users after last night's RBAC role rename + IdP update. Provisioner logs show KMS decrypt failures followed by fallback creates. Can infra/security triage?

Rohit: ACK. Paste the smallest logs and the OIDC subject/assertion sample.

Maya: Logs (sanitized):
```
2026-08-02T02:14:03Z ERROR provisioner: decrypt extid failed: kms.InvalidCiphertextException: encryption context mismatch
  at kms.(*Client).Decrypt
  at provisioner.resolveExternalId
2026-08-02T02:14:03Z INFO provisioner: decrypt failed -> fallback to userName -> created svc-aurora-sync-3
```
OIDC sub we received: `sub=acct|12345|svc` (IdP flipped delimiter).

Emily: Two problems: 1) IdP changed subject format so our stable-id parser failed after RBAC rename; 2) KMS rewrap occurred earlier (alias/tenant-extid-aurora pointed to new key) and the new key's encryption context is missing tenant metadata -> Decrypt fails.

Jules: infra-bot, show KMS alias/history for alias/tenant-extid-aurora.

infra-bot: KMS: 2026-08-02T02:10:00Z AliasUpdate alias/tenant-extid-aurora -> keyId=ccc-101; ReEncrypt calls detected 02:11..02:13Z. DestinationEncryptionContext omitted "tenant": "aurora" in 12/67 rewraps.

Rohit: That explains InvalidCiphertextException. Destination context must include tenant to match our decrypt logic. Immediate mitigations: pause SCIM provisioning for aurora, rollback alias or rewrap back to canonical key with correct context, and prevent auto-create on decrypt failure.

Maya: Agreed. Short-term: toggle paused in controlplane (CS notified). Long-term: add a pre-decrypt audit row (ciphertext_hmac + reason) and a create-guard that prevents create when decrypt fails (enqueue to dedupe-review).

Emily: I'll open incident and own vuln triage for the rewrap issue (missing context could cause silent decryption failure across tenants). security-bot create incident.

security-bot: Incident created: SEC-2026-140 - "Missing EncryptionContext on extid rewrap -> SCIM dupes + RBAC/name mapping drift" https://redwood.incidents/SEC-2026-140

Jules: Plan: 1) Rohit to rollback alias or apply correct key-policy and run a targeted re-encrypt with DestinationEncryptionContext {"tenant":"aurora","purpose":"extid"} for affected blobs; 2) Maya to pause/unpause with CS coordination; 3) Emily to run vuln scope: list rewraps without tenant context and affected tenants; 4) Ship provisioner changes: shallow audit + create-guard.

Rohit: Running dry-run rewrap on 20 samples now: `infractl rewrap-extid --tenant=aurora --sample=20 --preserve-context --dest-context '{"tenant":"aurora","purpose":"extid"}'`

infra-bot: Dry-run results: 20/20 success with preserved context.

Maya: Thanks. I'll hold unpause until recon/dedupe complete. Rohit post rewrap output and Emily post scope results. Ping @oncall-bot if anything blocks. :white_check_mark:
